test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a true statement?

options.text: Sum of any pair of adjacent angles of a rhombus is not 180°.
Diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other at right angles.
All sides of a rhombus are congruent.

solution:
**Concept:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e4f2c2f3bb6884df69768bd3ac9f560de6db1488503d16edfd4111f42bea714.png] **

The above figure represents a Rhombus.

**Properties of Rhombus:**

 
• **All sides of the rhombus are equal.**
 
• **Diagonals bisect each other at 90º.**
 
• Opposite sides are parallel in a rhombus.
 
• Opposite angles are equal in a rhombus.
 
• **Adjacent angles add up to 180º**.
 
• All interior angles of a rhombus add up to 360º.
 
• **All the sides of square are equal in length and also diagonals bisect at each other at 90º ,hence all squares are rhombus but all rhombus are not squares because the sides of the rhombus may not form a 90º angle with each other.**

Hence, **Sum of any pair of adjacent angles of a rhombus is not 180°** is not a true statement about rhombus.
